svy = load("svy")
s = svy[svy.gender.isin([1, 2])]                      # 성별 통제 분석은 554명
fem = (s.gender == 2).astype(float)
h = s.hjs - s.hjs.mean()
r = s.refl - s.refl.mean()

prev = 0
for lab, X in [("1", [s.age, fem]),
               ("2", [s.age, fem, h]),
               ("3", [s.age, fem, h, r]),
               ("4", [s.age, fem, h, r, h * r])]:
    b, se, p, r2 = ols(s.mil, X)
    print(lab, round(r2, 4), round(r2 - prev, 4))
    prev = r2
# 1 0.0023 0.0023
# 2 0.3915 0.3892
# 3 0.3935 0.002
# 4 0.4185 0.0251

prev = 0
for lab, X in [("1", [s.age, fem]), ("2", [s.age, fem, h]),
               ("3", [s.age, fem, h, r, h * r])]:
    *_, r2 = ols(s.flr, X)
    print(lab, round(r2, 4), round(r2 - prev, 4)); prev = r2
b, se, p, _ = ols(s.flr, [s.age, fem, h, r, h * r])
print(round(b[3], 3), round(b[5], 3), round(p[5], 3))
# 1 0.0028 0.0028
# 2 0.1469 0.1441
# 3 0.1604 0.0135
# 0.425 0.097 0.004

b0, *_ = ols(s.mil, [h])                    # 통제 없음
b1, *_ = ols(s.mil, [s.age, fem, h])        # 나이·성별 통제
print(round(b0[1], 3), round(b1[3], 3))
# 0.982 0.981

b0, *_ = ols(s.mil, [s.hjs])              # 15장 §15.4에서 본 그것
b1, *_ = ols(s.mil, [s.hjs, s.gen])
print(round(b0[1], 3), round(b1[1], 3))
# 0.982 0.865

b1, se1, p1, r21 = ols(svy.mil, [svy.hjs])       # 의미를 여정으로 설명
b2, se2, p2, r22 = ols(svy.hjs, [svy.mil])       # 여정을 의미로 설명
print(round(r21, 4), round(r22, 4))
print(f"{p1[1]:.1e}", f"{p2[1]:.1e}")
# 0.3953 0.3953
# 1.3e-63 1.3e-63
